title: Comparative analysis of compound NSC13728 as Omomyc homodimer stabilizer by molecular dynamics simulation and MM/GBSA free energy calculation.
authors: Gao, Jian; Wang, Yinchuan; Li, Kaihang; Zhang, Jinyuan; Geng, Xiaoju
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和MM/GBSA计算研究小分子稳定Omomyc同源二聚体以抑制Myc-Max与DNA结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作背景，但核心是蛋白-蛋白二聚体稳定性，而非直接蛋白-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Myc is a master transcriptional regulator that controls almost all cellular processes, whose function is dependent on dimerization with its obligate partner Max. Stabilization of Max homodimer by small molecules (such as compound NSC13728) has proven an effective way to reduce the availability of Myc-Max dimer. Omomyc, a peptide inhibitor of Myc, is able to form Omomyc homodimer, which can competitively inhibit the binding of Myc-Max to the E-box of DNA. Considering the high amino acid sequence homology between Omomyc and Max, we put forward the hypothesis that Max-Max stabilizers could stabilize the Omomyc homodimer. Hence, through molecular dynamics (MD) simulation and molecular mechanics/generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) free energy calculation, we discovered that the stability of Omomyc-Omomyc is remarkably higher than that of Max-Max. Moreover, after adding the compound NSC13728 into the well-defined "Site 3," the binding affinity between two Omomyc monomers can be further increased. Compound NSC13728 has stronger binding interaction to Omomyc-Omomyc than to Max-Max. "Site 3" of Omomyc is more hydrophobic than that of Max, which enlightens us that the more potent Omomyc-Omomyc stabilizers may be hydrophobic in structure.
abstract_zh: Myc是一个主转录调控因子，控制着几乎所有细胞过程，其功能依赖于与其必需伙伴Max的二聚化。通过小分子（如化合物NSC13728）稳定Max同源二聚体已被证明是减少Myc-Max二聚体可用性的有效途径。Omomyc，一种Myc的肽抑制剂，能够形成Omomyc同源二聚体，从而竞争性抑制Myc-Max与DNA E-box的结合。鉴于Omomyc与Max之间高度的氨基酸序列同源性，我们提出假设：Max-Max稳定剂可能稳定Omomyc同源二聚体。因此，通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和分子力学/广义Born表面积（molecular mechanics/generalized Born surface area, MM/GBSA）自由能计算，我们发现Omomyc-Omomyc的稳定性显著高于Max-Max。此外，将化合物NSC13728添加到明确定义的“位点3”后，两个Omomyc单体之间的结合亲和力可进一步增强。化合物NSC13728与Omomyc-Omomyc的结合相互作用强于与Max-Max的结合。“位点3”在Omomyc中比在Max中更疏水，这启示我们，更有效的Omomyc-Omomyc稳定剂可能在结构上具有疏水性。
